transcript.text: Welcome to On Print shop in Orders we will see how to manage orders.
Under How to manage orders, we will see view update order, modify order, download invoice, Download file, download, shipping label, download, job ticket, bulk order, update and payment request.
We'll see how to manage orders in two parts.
In first part we'll see you update order, modify order.
Suppose one of your customer Richard Henry has logged into your website and placed an order.
Here you can see the order has been placed.
The order number is 1054.
Now same order will reflect in your admin panel.
When you go to your admin panel on the dashboard, it will show order number 1054.
When you click on this order number, you can directly go to that particular order or you can go to orders list order and go to that particular order.
You can see the order number 1054.
Now you can see the small icons over here.
These icons shows a different field like say this icon shows the repeated customer that it's a repeat customer and this icon shows the total number of products in the order and other icon details.
If you want to refer, you can refer it from the bottom of the page here.
Then you can see a drop down over here.
This drop down shows the quantity and the base price of the product.
Now when you click on action button, you can your update order from clicking on view update order.
After going on view update order, you can view orders detail from here under View orders tab like say customer detail, shipping address detail, billing address detail, payment and shipping.
Then the order product details you can see over here.
You can also modify design from here by clicking on this modify design button.
You can select the user design from the Select user design button.
You can ask for approval from this ask for approval button.
You can also ask for visual proof from here.
You can add the comment from here and notify the customer from here.
In the same way you can upload the design like say you can upload design from here from front and back button.
If you want to add more design, you can click on add more button and add more design from here.
And same way you can ask for approval from here as well as visual proof from here.
You can add the comments and notify the customer from here and just click the save button.
So this is how you can modify the design from here and the order history you can see from here.
Now when you update the order, when you click on update order button to update the order, you can change status of the order from here.
You can change the due date from here.
You can change PO number from here.
You can change the shipping method from here.
You can change add the shipping company name here.
You can add tracking number here.
You can select sales agent from here.
You can select branch from here.
You can add a comment over here or you can select a predefined comment from here.
To notify the customer, you can select the notify customer button from here and you can upload a artwork from here.
From the upload file button just click on Upload file button and select the artwork and click on save.
So the order will be updated accordingly.
The details you have selected over here or added over here.
Now you can see that here is a tracking number.
When you add a tracking number here, you will be able to see this tracking number over here under payment and shipment shipping.
Now order is been updated.
Now we have update uploaded A artwork file.
So let's go to a storefront and see the artwork file.
Now when customers logs into the storefront, you can go to My account and go to the orders.
Click on the view button and under order history you can see the comments by the admin and you can download the file from here and you can view the uploaded artwork from here.
Then comes the update order product status.
So when customer clicks sorry, when you click on a update artwork then comes update order product.
So to update order product just click on the step Update order product and you can update the product of the order.
Like say you can select user can download print ready file from here.
Then upload the artwork from here you can select the comment or add a comment here.
You can select the order product status from here.
Like say right now the order product status is proof approved.
Suppose I change it to cutting and finishing and click on save button.
So this product order status I have changed from 2 February to cutting and finishing.
Now when customers goes to the storefront, logs in and goes to my account and click on view button, you can see the order product status is changed and it is displayed over here.
So this is how you can update order product status.
Then comes the order shipments.
So if you need to create a order shipments you can click on order shipments over here and create the shipment.
You can create the shipment order wise or product wise.
If you want to create order wise then you can add the shipping company name, tracking number and package length, width and height and package weight here.
And if you select order product wise, then you will need to Add all the details product wise like say for this product, you can add weight and package length, width and height over here.
And for this product, you can add the weight and package length, width and height over here.
And you can add the shipping company name and tracking number from here.
Then if you click on this action button, you can assign job to printer, modify order, download invoice, Download file, download job ticket, impose order and archive order.
So this is how you can view update order.
Then comes assign job to printer.
So when you click on action button and click on assign job to printer here you will need to select the printer.
So you can select the printer from here for both the products you can select different printers.
Also you can add a comment over here notify customer yes or no and seven back.
So the job will be assigned to the printer.
So now you can see a little icon over here, the yellow icon, it shows the printer assigned.
So this job is assigned to the printer.
Now you can modify order from modify order here.
Click on Modify order under Modify order.
You can see the customer details here.
You can manage the shipping address from this Manage shipping address button from here.
You can manage billing address from manage addresses from here.
You can see the payment and shipping details here.
Then comes the order product details.
So you can modify the order product details here.
Like say you can modify the design from here.
Then you can change the additional attributes or additional options from here or add a additional attribute or additional option from here.
Then you can change the quantity here.
You can change the price from here.
You can even go to online price calculator to change the quantity and additional option and check the prices and view the prices.
You can see the prices here and you can make changes to the prices over here accordingly.
Even from these buttons, you can calculate the shipping rate, calculate reward points and calculate tax.
You can change or add reward points over here under reward points.
You can add the comment here and notify customer yes and no and then click on save and the order will be modified.
Now for example after placing an order, your customer contacts you and says that I have forgot to add a product to the order or I want to add a product to the order.
So in that case we can add a new product to this order by clicking on this Add new order product button.
Just click on Add new order product button.
From here you you can select the product type like say existing product or custom product.
Suppose I select existing product then you can select the product from here for example 3D mouse pad.
Now you will need to Add all the details here like the quantity, product weight, production days, additional options etcetera.
So to add the and the product price also.
So to Add all these details just click on online price calculator, select the details from here like say size, quantity, additional options and then you can click on Apply only options or apply all.
If you click on apply only options, it will apply only the additional options.
And if you click on apply all, it will apply all the details including size, price and everything.
Let's say you can see the quantity, production days, the additional options and price.
Everything is added over here.
You can change the artwork name from here and from upload file, you can upload the artwork and then you click on save and continue.
So when you click on save and continue, the product is added.
Now here it shows that the product is out of stock.
So we will need to change the product.
So for example, we change the product to say 16 point business card and then click on save and continue.
So now the product is added.
You can see over here the product 16 point business card has been added to this order.
Now when you go to storefront as a customer and go to My accounts and click on action, here you can see the added product.
So under how to manage orders today we have seen how to view update order, how to assign job to printer and how to modify the order.
Thank you for watching this video.
